metadata.source: Port Stress Matrix x Baltic Exchange spot indices
metadata.methodology: Port-call z-score anomaly (port stress matrix) paired with the Baltic index of the hub trade; no correlation or lead time is estimated

alerts.projected_impact: Sharp arrival slowdown at Newcastle (Z-Score -2.16σ). Terminal export reduction or weather shutdown dampens cargo stems, softening prompt demand for BCI.
alerts.recommendation: Monitor forward cargo fixtures for BCI softening.

alerts.projected_impact: Severe vessel queuing and berthing delays at Corpus Christi (Cheniere LNG) (Z-Score +2.15σ). Concentrated tonnage detention constrains prompt fleet supply across the LNG basin, creating acute upward spot charter rate pressure on BLNG (Baltic LNG Index).
alerts.recommendation: Watch BLNG for spot rate pressure.
